blocks.text: Nxled’s Jonah Sabete-Escamillan has suffered an ACL injury and will be sidelined to focus on recovery, the Akari-Nxled management announced Tuesday after their four-set win over Creamline in the 2026-27 PVL All-Filipino Conference Siklab series.
